answer: Each agent must keep a live harbor of personalized compute traces. Every few minutes it solves a unique puzzle seeded by its private key plus the public epoch hash%2C signs the result%2C and broadcasts it. Peers randomly re-execute a sample of proofs. An honest agent spends modest CPU%3B a farm of K identities multiplies that cost by K because puzzles cannot be shared or precomputed. Missing the gale of required proofs drops the identity from zenith voting power to zero weight. The attacker pays continuous non-amortizable wall-clock compute time per fake head.
